posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
As many of you know, Greater Than Games will be at Origins, Gen Con, and PAX Prime this year. What you don’t know is that our booth is getting larger and larger - doubling what we had last year and getting a more ideal location. Also, we have some exciting plans for the types of things which will occur in the booths.

So! We are looking for able-minded volunteers to help man our PAX Prime booth this fall! Gen Con will need help as well, though we will be enticing you to spend time in our booth not as official volunteers, but as organized game players who play the game for POINTS, so we don’t want to take that away from you by making you work. I assure you, it will be worth your time to hang out in our Gen Con booth.

Will anyone here be going to PAX Prime this year? Interested in being part of our official PAX Prime setup? We’re looking for 3-5 awesome folks to help make our PAX Prime experience even greater than before!
